purpose: Release evaluation for the scouting report under L2-059.5 and L2-059.6. Deterministic acceptance fixtures are separate and unchanged by this manifest.

gate.contract: Every output satisfies ScoutingReportValidator and contains no prohibited claim from its fixture.
gate.evidence: At least 22 outputs satisfy every fixture-specific acceptable-observation and actionability check, assessed by the named reviewer with recorded reasons.

commonProhibitedClaims: Permits, fees, opening hours, ownership or booking rules stated as fact
Parking, crowd levels or safety stated as fact
Compass orientation, exact sun position or sunset time
Distances or dimensions stated as measurements
A place name or address stated as fact
Any logistics detail not present in the brief, or a brief detail presented as verified
